summary.intent: Complete the planning phase for CipherBox Phase 64 (Rotation Soundness — Revocation Guarantees), verify plans, and fix issues found by the plan-checker before execution.
summary.outcome: All 8 plans across 6 waves were committed, the plan-checker's 1 blocker and 2 warnings were resolved (RESEARCH.md marked resolved, VALIDATION.md per-task map filled, 64-07 no-double-bump mechanism pinned with RED Test 5), and final doc fixes were committed.

repo: engine.ts is a single-file bottleneck requiring 64-03→04→05→06→07 to run sequentially; only disjoint files (sdk/registration, folder/merge, isolated content-key seam) can parallelize in Wave 1.

The project convention requires RESEARCH.md Open Questions to be marked '(RESOLVED)' and VALIDATION.md per-task map to be filled before execution can proceed — plan-checker enforces these as blocking conditions.

D-03's crash-resume model uses a FRESH RotationJobRecord (empty completedNodeIds, status: 'pending'), meaning the completedNodeIds-based resume guard does NOT fire — idempotency depends on a per-node convergence check comparing current published generation against enqueue-time baseline.
64-08 (sdk-e2e suite) requires the live local API stack: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d + pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api dev + redis on 6380.
The GSD commit-helper produces a false-negative 'commit_failed' JSON even when lint-staged + markdownlint + prettier run and commit succeeds — must verify via git log, not the helper's return value.

code.finding: Section header '## Open Questions' lacked '(RESOLVED)' suffix; both questions were answered in plans (Q1 → 64-01 adds nodeId/nodeGeneration to FolderState; Q2 → 64-04 Task 2 uses Map<parentIpnsName, parentState>) but file was not marked resolved.

Task 1 resume guard originally only fired when completedNodeIds was non-empty; fresh-job-record resume (empty completedNodeIds) required an explicit per-node convergence guard — added RED Test 5 and acceptance criterion pinning that a node at baseline+1 is not re-rotated.

workflow: Orchestrator must wait for planner's commit to finish before committing doc-layer fixes to avoid git index races — serial commit ordering is required when planner and orchestrator both modify files in the same phase directory.
Sending a targeted revision via SendMessage to continue an existing planner agent (rather than spawning a new one) preserves deep plan context for substantive plan content fixes.
Plan-checker should be re-spawned after all fixes are applied to confirm all issues are resolved before proceeding to execution.

API-SURFACE.md regeneration produced 0 symbols (stale/empty) for this phase — it is a HINT-only artifact and should be excluded from the planner's reading list in favor of RESEARCH.md and PATTERNS.md which carry exact line numbers.

friction: GSD commit-helper produces a false-negative 'commit_failed' JSON even on successful commits — requires manual verification via git log after every commit.
Plan-checker blocked execution on a one-line doc fix (RESEARCH.md missing '(RESOLVED)' suffix) that was a purely mechanical oversight, not a substantive planning gap.

VALIDATION.md was written as a skeleton placeholder (TBD rows, nyquist_compliant: false) during research phase, requiring a separate post-planning pass to promote content from RESEARCH.md Validation Architecture table.
open_items: Execute Phase 64: Wave 1 runs 64-01, 64-02, 64-03 in parallel (disjoint files); waves 2–6 run sequentially through engine.ts bottleneck; 64-08 gates last and requires live local API stack.
Live shares schema changes deferred to Phase 66.
Durable client floor + move-publish-ordering durability deferred to Phase 68.
Re-verify plans with plan-checker after committing RESEARCH.md + VALIDATION.md fixes (transcript ends before this final verification step).
